objective: Build the governed cost, licensing and data-rights baseline for P01-B/P01-C candidates using current official/public evidence, explicit quote-required fields and scenario-based cost assumptions without purchasing services or selecting production providers.
scope: Collect public subscription and usage cost evidence for market-data candidates
Collect public trading fee / commission / market-data cost evidence for execution candidates where published
Separate vendor subscription fees, exchange/index pass-through fees, usage fees, trading fees, spreads/funding and infrastructure/operational costs
Record professional/non-professional classification dependencies without inferring Owner status
Record internal display, non-display, automated-analysis, algorithmic-trading, storage, raw-retention, derived-data/model-training and redistribution rights
Mark unpublished or contract-specific terms UNKNOWN / QUOTE_REQUIRED / CONTRACT_REVIEW
Create scenario-based monthly/annual cost model with formulas instead of invented exact totals
Define evidence freshness and revalidation cadence
Reconcile Current State and Task Catalog and hand off to P01-F
out_of_scope: Create credentials, API keys or accounts
Select final primary/backup provider or execution venue
Infer Owner residence, tax residency or professional/non-professional status
Enable Demo, Shadow, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Every numeric public price has source/as-of metadata or is marked estimate/unknown
Market-data rights and trading authorization remain separate
No provider or broker is declared production-selected
Scenario cost formulas distinguish fixed, variable, pass-through and quote-required costs
security_tests: No credentials, subscriptions, account creation or funding
evidence: Official exchange/index entitlement/licensing pages where relevant
Official broker/exchange fee pages where relevant
rollback: Revert P01-E research artifacts and state/catalog changes only. No subscriptions, accounts, credentials, contracts or runtime changes are made.
definition_of_done: Data-rights fields and quote-required gaps recorded
Owner-specific classification remains explicit future Human Gate where required
Task Catalog and Current State reconciled
